'''Utterance of Marvels: I''' is the first part in the [[Prologue]] chapter of the [[Main Quests]].

==Synopsis==
A [[Mysterious Woman|mysterious woman]] gives the main character their [[Tacet Mark]] on their wrist before pushing them into an ocean of frequencies. When they wake up in the [[Gorges of Spirits|Gorges Of Spirits]], they are found by [[Yangyang]] and [[Chixia]], who give them the nickname [[Rover]]. During their meeting, Yangyang senses the [[Etheric Sea]] approaching, prompting the group to leave. While roaming the area, Rover gets a vision of the [[Sentinel]], [[Jué|Jue]], when faced with His statue and learns He is the Sentinel of [[Jinzhou]]. Upon reaching the exit, the trio find [[Baizhi]] inspecting a [[Tacet Field]] that manifests an [[Crownless|unknown]] [[Tacet Discord]]. The TD leaves behind an [[Echo]] but when Rover fails to absorb it with their [[terminal]], a [[Abby|mysterious voice]] inside their Tacet Mark forcefully absorbs the Echo. After this, Yangyang recalls the legend of how the first Echo came to be, saying that a powerful Resonator was able to absorb a strong Echo with their bare hands and thus was able to establish Huanglong.

Shortly after, a message is received from Jinzhou's Magistrate, [[Jinhsi]]. She talks about the upcoming [[Moon-Chasing Festival|Moon-chasing Festival]] and asks for Rover to meet her at the [[Jinzhou City Hall|City Hall]], anticipating their arrival. The group conclude that Rover must be someone important to Jinzhou and lead them into the city.

:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_5.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' My fellow soldiers and citizens, I apologize for any inconvenience caused. I am [[Jinhsi]], the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_6.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' As the {{color|help|[[Moon-chasing Festival]]|nobold=1}} approaches, our city welcomes visitors from around the world. The festivities are highly anticipated by our people, and I, too, share in this joyful sentiment.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_7.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Jinzhou has always been a crucial defense against the Tacet Discord Outbreaks, safeguarding Huanglong. We have a heavy responsibility on our shoulders with no room for retreat or failure.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_8.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' It is the dedication of our warriors, along with the diligence of our citizens, that has allowed us to thrive in peace and prosperity.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_9.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Despite the challenges of Tacet Discord, we remain steadfast and hospitable to visitors, upholding our enduring traditions.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_10.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' With that in mind, I have a favor to ask.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_11.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Among our visitors, there is one {{color|help|visitor|nobold=1}} that holds utmost importance to me, the City of Jinzhou, and the entirety of Huanglong.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_12.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' We have awaited your arrival for a long time.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_14.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Given the circumstances, you may be feeling bewildered at this time.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_15.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' You should have noticed some strange happenings related to you.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_16.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' If you plan to stay in Jinzhou for some time, I would be more than delighted to personally meet you in the City Hall of Jinzhou.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_17.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' While I cannot guarantee to provide all the answers you need, I will do my best to assist you and provide necessary permissions, if applicable.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_18.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' This is only my personal request. You can decide your course of action in any way you see fit.
:{{A|Vo hlmq xz 21_19.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Therefore, I request the people and soldiers of Jinzhou to assist this esteemed visitor when the opportunity arises.
